newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs dive as Nissan Life woes trigger rate fears.
newsitem.headline: JGBs dive as Nissan Life woes trigger rate fears.

text.p: * Key June JGBs ended sharply down as Nissan Life's business suspension triggered fears of higher interest rates. Japan's low interest policy was blamed for low return on investments. * Concerns over sale of assets, including yen bonds by Nissan as well as other life insurers, also dampened sentiment.
